description: Blood and gunfire effects. Positions and offsets in Q12 metres (4096 = 1 m), times in Q12 seconds. blood_hits: by hit strength (the attack's blood_splatter, the list index), the sprays and splats ([min, max], a random number) and their size. body_pools: by death pose, the blood pool patches under a corpse. muzzle_flashes and gun_smoke: the flash and smoke kinds a gun can use. guns: per weapon or shooter name, flash and smoke are indices into muzzle_flashes and gun_smoke (flash null: no flash, the smoke comes anyway), puffs the number of smoke slots taken, flash_angles a fixed [yaw, pitch] instead of the shot's aim, bones and muzzle where the flash sits, muzzle_light the light of the flash (colour, intensity, range, radius in metres, fade, casts_shadows, gi; rendering only) for the guns of story characters that have no weapon file, as gamedata/weapons/<Name>.json gives it to the player's guns. Every key is checked: an unknown key is an error. A mod changes it with a file of the same path in its own folder; objects are merged key by key, so the patch only needs the keys it changes.

blood_hits.description: splats [min, max]: a random number of splats.
Strength 9 sprays at the point itself and ages twice as fast.

body_pools.description: By death pose: size of each patch (grows by up to a quarter at random); patches [forward_range, forward_base, side_range, side_base], each offset base + rand % range, laid last first.

muzzle_flashes.description: Effect slot kinds 15..19 in order. life: Q12 seconds; length and half_width: size of a flash blade in the bone's units; swirl: the wobble of its spin; muzzle: the point in the bone's space; bones: 'weapon' (the shooter's gun) or 'second' (an NPC's gun).

gun_smoke.description: Effect slot kinds 20..22 in order; a puff starts drifting once older than drift_after and is gone at life (Q12 seconds).
